# A11-S02: Press reception

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

Fortunately, it is 18. global goals included in all the articles that take
their starting point from AFP's message - so I can easily gather 50 or more
articles for him :-) by “perfect” I probably also meant that this one
is the first to describe exactly what I have thought myself, but have had to
hold back a little regarding academic and artistic forebears, haha.

I have at least put some of them in MyNewsDesk! This one was behind
a paywall, but the journalist sent it to me today, so it is more difficult
to link to.

There are also several who write around the world and want to help,
I try to keep them on their toes.

And yes, I also think this will give us a great tailwind (also on the
bike lane) :-D
